entities.summary:
Ismenias was a key Theban politician of the 4th century BC, serving as leader of the Theban democratic faction during the late Classical period.










Ismenias played a pivotal role in shaping the governance of Thebes, implementing policies aimed at strengthening the city-state's economy and defense. He was known for his efforts to promote education and the arts, as well as his involvement in the construction of several public buildings, including the Temple of Apollo.





Ismenias' legacy can be seen in the enduring legacy of Theban democracy, which influenced the development of later Greek city-states. His policies and achievements also had a lasting impact on the region, contributing to the growth and prosperity of Thebes during the 4th century BC.






Ismenias' life and achievements are documented in several ancient sources, including the works of the Greek historian Herodotus, who noted his role in the Theban democracy.
